arguments.sql:
WITH stock AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS inventory_lines,
           SUM(qty) AS total_stock, MAX(purchased) AS latest_purchase_date,
           SUM(CASE WHEN purchased >= '2019-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inventory_lines_purchased_in_2019_or_later
    FROM main.inventory_with_dims
    GROUP BY product_id
), budget AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS months, MIN(mth) AS first_month, MAX(mth) AS last_month
    FROM main.monthly_budget
    WHERE mth >= '2019-01-01' AND mth < '2020-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_id
), sales AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS months, MAX(mth) AS last_month
    FROM main.monthly_sales
    GROUP BY product_id
), orders AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS orders_months, SUM(qty) AS ordered_qty
    FROM main.monthly_orders
    WHERE mth >= '2019-01-01' AND mth < '2020-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_id
), totals AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_product, SUM(qty) AS total_qty
    FROM main.inventory_totals
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id AS product_id, m.qty_minimum, m.qty_purchase,
       i.inventory_lines, i.total_stock, t.rows_per_product, t.total_qty,
       i.latest_purchase_date, i.inventory_lines_purchased_in_2019_or_later,
       b.months AS budget_months, b.first_month, b.last_month, s.last_month AS latest_sales_month,
       o.orders_months, o.ordered_qty
FROM main.products AS p
LEFT JOIN main.product_minimums AS m ON m.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN stock AS i ON i.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN totals AS t ON t.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN sales AS s ON s.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.product_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.id

WITH demand_sources AS (
    SELECT 'budget' AS source, product_id, mth, qty
    FROM main.monthly_budget
    WHERE mth >= '2019-01-01' AND mth < '2020-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'orders', product_id, mth, qty
    FROM main.monthly_orders
    WHERE mth >= '2019-01-01' AND mth < '2020-01-01'
)
SELECT d.product_id, d.mth,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN d.source = 'budget' THEN 1 END) AS budget_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.source = 'budget' THEN d.qty END) AS budget_qty,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN d.source = 'orders' THEN 1 END) AS order_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.source = 'orders' THEN d.qty END) AS ordered_qty
FROM demand_sources AS d
JOIN main.product_minimums AS p ON p.product_id = d.product_id
GROUP BY d.product_id, d.mth
ORDER BY d.product_id, d.mth
